title: Idea Grounding Report
description: IDEATE/VERIFY-stage artifact (absorption wave 1; ScholarEval pattern). Output of tools/idea_grounding.py: retrieval-grounded soundness / contribution signals per idea, derived from how the idea's evidence refs intersect live-retrieved neighbors. SCORE-ONLY discipline (novelty-paradox guard): EVERY input idea appears in the output, none are dropped or filtered, no verdict field — thresholds (from profiles/*.yaml) only annotate, never cut. The director ranks/bets at /idea-bet.

soundness.description: How well the idea's stated evidence is supported by retrieved literature (grounded-support density).

contribution.description: How far the idea sits from its retrieved neighbors (distinctness given grounding).

grounded_refs.description: The idea's evidence refs that were confirmed against retrieval (may be empty — that itself is signal).

below_threshold.description: Annotation only (profile thresholds); NEVER a cut.

thresholds.description: Echo of the active profile's idea_grounding thresholds used for annotation.
